options.name: description
options.description: Help text, referenced by the thumbs.

options.name: step
options.description: Values snap to min + n * step.

options.name: largeStep
options.description: Page Up/Page Down step (default: a tenth of the scale in whole steps).

options.name: value
options.description: A number, or [start, end] with range.

options.name: marks
options.description: true: a tick per step (up to 100); or explicit { value, label? } marks.

options.name: format
options.description: Number format of the value text.

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name (hidden inputs; a range submits two values).

options.name: showValue
options.description: Show the value next to the label.

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of the value text and thumb names.

properties.name: value
properties.description: A number, or [start, end] with range.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: Valid unless a custom error is set.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set the value, snapped and clamped (no event).

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear the error.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; the value is re-snapped.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, and the form registration.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The value changes while dragging or with a key: { value }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The value was committed (pointer release or a key): { value }.

cssClasses.name: aui-slider__mark | __mark--active | __mark-label
cssClasses.description: A tick, an active tick, and its label.
